slides.sub: Shipping fast, competitive pressure, decisive calls — the sprint season.

slides.body: Mars (Mangala) dasha runs 7 years. Energy, drive and appetite for action rise. The question stops being 'what should we plan?' and becomes 'what can we ship now?'

slides.h2: Why it's different from Rahu Dasha
slides.body: Rahu Dasha tests unconventional directions. Mars Dasha asks you to pick one and execute hard. It rewards commitment, not exploration.

points: Physical and mental stamina for long pushes
Willingness to take on hard conversations
Picking fights that don't need fighting
Impatience with people who move slower
Burnout from running at full throttle

slides.body: Channel the drive into one or two clear targets. Add a review step before shipping and a recovery routine after. Mars gives energy; you supply the direction.
